UserArtwork.title: UserArtwork
UserArtwork.description: A private drawing saved by an authenticated MoonArt user in their personal gallery.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created and owns this artwork.

imageDataUrl.description: Compressed PNG/WebP/JPEG data URL of the artwork fitting safely within Firestore document limits.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when artwork was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when artwork was last updated.

SharedArtwork.title: SharedArtwork
SharedArtwork.description: A publicly shared MoonArt drawing visible to all authenticated users for 24 hours.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

authorName.description: Public display name of the author (no email or PII).

authorPhotoUrl.description: Optional public avatar URL of the author.

sourceArtworkId.description: Identifier linking back to the author's gallery item or canvas document.

title.description: Public title of the shared artwork.

imageDataUrl.description: Compressed image data URL of the shared artwork.

heartCount.description: Total hearts collected for the current editRevision; resets to 0 on owner edit.

editRevision.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter incremented whenever the owner edits the shared artwork.

sharedAt.description: Server timestamp when the artwork was shared.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared artwork was last modified.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp exactly 24 hours after sharing.

ArtworkLike.title: ArtworkLike
ArtworkLike.description: Represents a single verified user heart on a specific editRevision of a shared artwork.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who hearted the artwork.

editRevision.description: Revision number of the shared artwork that was hearted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the heart was recorded.

/users/{userId}/artworks/{artworkId}.description: Private personal artwork gallery scoped strictly to each authenticated user.

/sharedArtworks/{artworkId}.description: Public 24-hour shared artwork feed visible to authenticated users while non-expired.

/sharedArtworks/{artworkId}/likes/{likeI.description: Atomic per-user per-revision heart records enforcing 1 heart per user per revision.
